```{r}

lagrange <- function(x, y) {
 n <- length(x)
 coeff <- numeric(n)
 for (i in 1:n){
   p = 1
   denom = 1
   
   for (j in 1:n){
     if ( j != i){
     
     q = numeric(length(p) + 1)
     
     for (k in seq_along(p)){
       q[k] = q[k] - x[j] * p[k]
       q[k+1] = q[k+1] + p[k]
     }
     
     p <- q
     denom <- denom * (x[i] - x[j])
     }
     }
   
   coeff = coeff + y[i] * (p / denom)
 }
 return(coeff)
}
```


## Test cases

```{r tests}
tests <- list(
  list(
    name = "Single point",
    x = c(2),
    y = c(5),
    expected = c(5)
  ),
  list(
    name = "Linear polynomial",
    x = c(0, 2),
    y = c(1, 5),
    expected = c(1, 2)
  ),
  list(
    name = "Quadratic polynomial",
    x = c(0, 2, 3),
    y = c(1, 3, 0),
    expected = c(1, 11/3, -4/3)
  ),
  list(
    name = "Polynomial through origin",
    x = c(0, 1, 2),
    y = c(0, 1, 4),
    expected = c(0, 0, 1)
  ),
  list(
    name = "Constant function",
    x = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
    y = c(7, 7, 7, 7),
    expected = c(7, 0, 0, 0)
  ),
  list(
    name = "Cubic polynomial",
    x = c(-1, 0, 1, 2),
    y = c(-7, -1, -1, 1),
    expected = c(-1, 5/3, -3, 4/3)
  ),
  list(
    name = "Negative x values",
    x = c(-2, 0, 2),
    y = c(5, 1, 5),
    expected = c(1, 0, 1)
  ),
  list(
    name = "Unsorted x values",
    x = c(3, 0, 2),
    y = c(0, 1, 3),
    expected = c(1, 11/3, -4/3)
  )
)

results <- data.frame(
  Test = character(),
  Passed = logical(),
  Expected = character(),
  Actual = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (test in tests) {
  actual <- lagrange(test$x, test$y)

  passed <- isTRUE(all.equal(
    as.numeric(actual),
    test$expected,
    tolerance = 1e-8
  ))

  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
    Test = test$name,
    Passed = passed,
    Expected = paste(round(test$expected, 6), collapse = ", "),
    Actual = paste(round(actual, 6), collapse = ", ")
  ))
}

knitr::kable(results)
```

## Summary

```{r summary}
cat("Passed:", sum(results$Passed), "/", nrow(results), "\n")

if (all(results$Passed)) {
  cat("All tests passed!\n")
} else {
  cat("Some tests failed. Check the Actual and Expected columns.\n")
}
```
